_doc: Registry of design-system families in the Spectrums gallery. Consumed by catalog/_check_ds.mjs (F5 coverage gate), and reused by the F6 scaffolder + F7 Showcase. Two tiers: 'themePack' systems are held to the epic's 100-facet standard and the token-only/offline/reduced-motion rules; 'legacy' families predate the standard (the original 9 spectrums), intentionally hardcode their brand palette (the fixed palette IS the design language's identity), and carry ONE shared reduced-motion block in #spectrums-styles rather than per-facet — so they are grandfathered OUT of the strict gate. See design-system-epic (JFH-33): the ~1,668 existing facets are not re-authored.
_themePackNote: Theme-pack systems are added here as they ship (JFH-67 Duolingo, JFH-68 Mailchimp, JFH-69 Stack Overflow, JFH-70 Monzo, JFH-71 Heroku, …). Each entry: { dsShort, name, ticket }. Once listed, _check_ds.mjs enforces exactly 100 facets + integrity for that dsShort. Until any ship, the gate validates whatever theme-pack families it is given (e.g. a staged temp copy) and treats legacy families as informational.
